methods.name: public static List<String> getCookieInfo(@NonNull CookieManager cookieManager, @NonNull String url)
methods.comment: * Gets all the cookies for the given URL along with their set attributes. * The cookies are returned in the format of the HTTP 'Set-Cookie' header as defined in * the RFC6265 spec. * eg. "name=value; domain=.example.com; path=/" * * @param cookieManager The CookieManager instance to get info from. * @param url the URL for which the API retrieves all available cookies. * @return the cookies as a list of strings.

methodNames: public static List<String> getCookieInfo(@NonNull CookieManager cookieManager, @NonNull String url)
